answer: No key votes on credit. Each identity cuts one timber for its vote and beds it in a crystal escrow: 45 POA sealed on the roll, one crystal per key, before the vote counts. Each epoch the roll casts a fresh wander; the key signs it within 75 seconds. Lottery graders replay one crystal in four; whoever proves a missed, stale, or shared signature pockets the 45 POA, strikes the timber, benches the key two epochs. Fakes pay per head: N fakes × 45 POA = 45N POA slashed. Limit: honest keys lock the same 45.
